sap.title: A goods receipt arrives after month end
sap.input: Purchasing has the purchase order and the warehouse has recorded delivery, but accounts payable cannot match the invoice.
sap.decision: Walk the receipt, invoice and posting dates through a test company code with a finance owner. Check tolerance rules and who can release an exception.
sap.output: An agreed three-way match test pack and a named owner for blocked invoices.

oracle-fusion.title: A new business unit needs its first close
oracle-fusion.input: The entity shares suppliers with its parent but uses a different approval chain and reporting currency.
oracle-fusion.decision: Map the ledger, business unit, procurement roles and reporting requirements before loading opening balances.
oracle-fusion.output: A reconciled trial balance, tested supplier invoice and signed-off close checklist.

salesforce.title: Pipeline reports count the same deal twice
salesforce.input: An inbound demo creates a lead even though the account owner already has an open opportunity.
salesforce.decision: Review matching rules, lead conversion and account assignment using a small set of known duplicate records.
salesforce.output: A repeatable conversion path that preserves campaign history and routes the deal to one owner.

microsoft-business-applications.title: An accepted quote never reaches finance
microsoft-business-applications.input: Sales maintains the quote in Dynamics while finance rekeys it into the order system.
microsoft-business-applications.decision: Agree the customer identifier, tax fields and point at which an accepted quote can be amended. Test a rejected order as well as an accepted one.
microsoft-business-applications.output: A traceable quote-to-order flow with a queue for finance exceptions.

enterprise-automation-integration.title: A supplier update reaches only one system
enterprise-automation-integration.input: A master-data change succeeds in procurement and times out while updating the ERP.
enterprise-automation-integration.decision: Use the supplier ID to check the destination before retrying. Decide which application owns payment terms and who resolves conflicting values.
enterprise-automation-integration.output: A reconciled supplier record and an exception that operations can replay safely.

application-modernisation.title: Replace one part of an order monolith
application-modernisation.input: Checkout and billing share a release cycle. A small billing fix currently needs a full storefront release.
application-modernisation.decision: Trace the dependencies around invoice generation, define the interface and compare both paths against the same completed orders.
application-modernisation.output: A separately deployable billing component with reconciliation and a documented rollback.

connected-experiences.title: A customer starts online and finishes on the phone
connected-experiences.input: The contact centre cannot see the information already captured during an abandoned online application.
connected-experiences.decision: Agree which fields can follow a signed-in customer, how consent is recorded and when an agent should resume a saved application.
connected-experiences.output: A cross-channel journey test that covers resume, expiry and a change of contact details.

process-automation.title: Resolve a purchase exception
process-automation.input: Buyers spend time chasing the same approval when a purchase exceeds the receiving team's threshold.
process-automation.decision: Capture the thresholds and delegation rules. Test a split order and an absent approver before turning on reminders.
process-automation.output: An approval queue with dates, delegates and a documented exception route.

delivery-foundations.title: Make a release reproducible
delivery-foundations.input: A fix passes on the developer's laptop but fails in test because the environment uses different settings.
delivery-foundations.decision: Write down environment dependencies, build once and promote the same artefact. Rehearse rollback on the test environment.
delivery-foundations.output: A repeatable release checklist and an artefact the support team can identify.

data-engineering-platforms.title: A dashboard loses late-arriving transactions
data-engineering-platforms.input: The sales feed closes at midnight while returns arrive the next morning against earlier order dates.
data-engineering-platforms.decision: Choose a change marker and replay window. Reprocess one day twice and check that orders and returns still reconcile.
data-engineering-platforms.output: A documented ingestion contract and a reconciliation report for the data owner.

analytics-reporting.title: Two reports disagree on net revenue
analytics-reporting.input: Finance recognises credits on posting date. Sales subtracts them on the customer's original order date.
analytics-reporting.decision: Calculate both definitions against the same invoice sample. Agree which definition belongs in each decision and label the time basis explicitly.
analytics-reporting.output: A governed metric definition with drill-through to the underlying transactions.

ai-enablement.title: Pilot an internal policy assistant
ai-enablement.input: HR wants faster answers but policies differ by location and some pages are obsolete.
ai-enablement.decision: Curate current documents, define access boundaries and test questions that should trigger a referral to HR.
ai-enablement.output: A reviewed answer set, documented failure modes and a decision on the pilot's next release.

mlops.title: A forecasting model changes its input distribution
mlops.input: A forecasting pipeline still runs after a product hierarchy change, but the mix of categories has shifted.
mlops.decision: Check feature distributions and back-test the candidate model by category. Agree the rollback trigger with the forecast owner.
mlops.output: A versioned model release with monitoring and a known-good fallback.

cloud-transformation.title: Move the service behind an overnight batch
cloud-transformation.input: An application looks independent until the team discovers a scheduled on-premise file transfer.
cloud-transformation.decision: Map that dependency, choose the migration wave and rehearse a cutover that includes the overnight job.
cloud-transformation.output: A tested move sequence and business-owner reconciliation after the batch finishes.

devops-ci-cd.title: Ship the same build through every environment
devops-ci-cd.input: Production is rebuilt from source after QA signs off, so the artefact under test can differ from the one released.
devops-ci-cd.decision: Build and identify the artefact once, promote it through the pipeline and test rollback with the release owner.
devops-ci-cd.output: A pipeline run that links a production release back to its build and test evidence.

platform-engineering.title: Give a new team its first service environment
platform-engineering.input: A product team needs a repository, runtime, telemetry and access before it can deploy its first endpoint.
platform-engineering.decision: Identify the common defaults, expose the choices teams actually need and test the path with a team using it for the first time.
platform-engineering.output: A documented self-service starter with operating ownership and an upgrade path.

reliability-cost.title: Investigate a costly overnight workload
reliability-cost.input: Compute spend rises after a batch change while the customer-facing service target stays flat.
reliability-cost.decision: Separate baseline capacity from the job's peak usage. Test scheduling or sizing against completion time and recovery requirements.
reliability-cost.output: A cost decision linked to the service target and a dashboard for recurrence.

strategy-roadmap.title: Sequence three competing platform investments
strategy-roadmap.input: A CRM replacement, data clean-up and portal launch all need the same integration team.
strategy-roadmap.decision: Map shared dependencies and identify the business decision each investment enables. Compare the cost of delaying each release.
strategy-roadmap.output: A phased roadmap with decision owners and dependencies visible to sponsors.

architecture-leadership.title: Agree who owns the customer record
architecture-leadership.input: Product teams propose different sources of truth and both already publish customer updates.
architecture-leadership.decision: Trace one update from creation to downstream consumption. Record who can overwrite each field and what happens during a conflict.
architecture-leadership.output: An architecture decision record with a migration path and review date.

vendor-platform-decisions.title: Compare two platforms on a difficult return
vendor-platform-decisions.input: Both vendors demonstrate order creation well. Your team also needs partial returns across two warehouses.
vendor-platform-decisions.decision: Give both vendors the same sample data and acceptance criteria. Record implementation dependencies, licence assumptions and support obligations.
vendor-platform-decisions.output: A scored comparison whose exceptions are visible alongside the commercial terms.

transformation-planning.title: Plan a rollout around a trading peak
transformation-planning.input: The new process touches stores, support and finance shortly before the busiest month.
transformation-planning.decision: Group sites by readiness, test one representative wave and agree stop conditions with operations.
transformation-planning.output: A wave plan with training owners, support coverage and a decision point before each cutover.

it-contract-staffing.title: Cover a cloud engineer's release assignment
it-contract-staffing.input: The requirement names Azure and Terraform, an overlap window and an end date tied to a release.
it-contract-staffing.decision: Separate the work the contractor must own from tools they only need to recognise. Confirm availability, shift and rate before submission.
it-contract-staffing.output: A shortlist with relevant project evidence and confirmed commercial and joining details.

project-based-staffing.title: Ramp a testing team ahead of UAT
project-based-staffing.input: The release plan needs test design first, execution next and defect triage during cutover.
project-based-staffing.decision: Map each role to its entry and exit milestone. Check whether the lead must remain through handover after execution finishes.
project-based-staffing.output: A role-by-phase staffing plan that shows start dates and dependencies.

high-volume-staffing.title: Staff two shifts at a new delivery centre
high-volume-staffing.input: A single headline target hides different location, language and shift requirements.
high-volume-staffing.decision: Break demand into shift-level cohorts, reserve interview capacity and track confirmed starts separately from offered candidates.
high-volume-staffing.output: A cohort tracker showing exactly which shift still has uncovered seats.

us-contract-staffing.title: Define a US team's remote delivery requirement
us-contract-staffing.input: A US manager requests a contractor but has not specified where the work will be performed.
us-contract-staffing.decision: Confirm work location, time-zone overlap, engagement entity and onboarding requirements with authorised stakeholders before sourcing.
us-contract-staffing.output: A location-specific brief that candidates and the client can evaluate on the same terms.

end-to-end-rpo.title: Take ownership from intake to joining
end-to-end-rpo.input: A business unit wants one recruiting partner to run requisitions across several hiring managers.
end-to-end-rpo.decision: Agree who can open a requisition, who approves changes and how long feedback stays with each interviewer.
end-to-end-rpo.output: A recruiting operating model covering intake, submission, interviews, offers and joining.

on-demand-rpo.title: Clear a short-term sourcing backlog
on-demand-rpo.input: The internal team can interview candidates but lacks capacity to start searches for a new product launch.
on-demand-rpo.decision: Set a time-box, assign named requisitions and document which activities return to the internal team when demand falls.
on-demand-rpo.output: A short-term recruiter allocation with an explicit handback date and live pipeline.

enterprise-rpo.title: Unify reporting across business units
enterprise-rpo.input: Three units count submissions, interviews and holds differently, making the monthly review unreliable.
enterprise-rpo.decision: Define stage entry and exit, agree what pauses a requisition and keep local approval exceptions visible.
enterprise-rpo.output: One reporting dictionary with unit-level views and escalation ownership.

permanent-hiring.title: Hire a finance systems analyst
permanent-hiring.input: An attractive CV shows implementation exposure, but the role owns month-end production support.
permanent-hiring.decision: Agree the first six months of work and screen for a real close-cycle incident. Align notice period and compensation before interviews.
permanent-hiring.output: A shortlist scored against the actual responsibilities and a clear offer pathway.

executive-search.title: Appoint a delivery leader for a new practice
executive-search.input: The CEO wants growth and the COO wants operating discipline, so candidates receive different briefs.
executive-search.decision: Resolve the first-year mandate, reporting line and decision rights before mapping the market. Agree who can see confidential candidate details.
executive-search.output: A calibrated target profile and shortlist with evidence against the agreed mandate.

software-development-roles.title: Recruit an engineer to own an API
software-development-roles.input: A job description asks for Java, React and cloud experience but the first release is a backend integration.
software-development-roles.decision: Ask the hiring manager which interface the engineer must own. Screen for implementation decisions and production debugging on comparable work.
software-development-roles.output: A shortlist distinguishing hands-on backend ownership from adjacent exposure.

servicenow-enterprise-platform-talent.title: Separate a platform architect from a developer
servicenow-enterprise-platform-talent.input: The requirement lists ITSM, ITOM and integrations under one generic ServiceNow title.
servicenow-enterprise-platform-talent.decision: Map design authority, configuration work and administration to the release milestone. Ask candidates which decisions and artefacts they personally owned.
servicenow-enterprise-platform-talent.output: Role-specific evidence against each platform workstream before submission.

data-ai-talent.title: Hire for a production data pipeline
data-ai-talent.input: A candidate can train a model but the vacancy owns ingestion, validation and daily recovery.
data-ai-talent.decision: Calibrate on the deliverable first. Screen for late data, failed runs and reconciliation with a named business owner.
data-ai-talent.output: An evidence-based shortlist for engineering, analytics or modelling according to the actual gap.

devops-cloud-talent.title: Find an engineer for a live on-call rotation
devops-cloud-talent.input: The team needs deployment automation and incident ownership, with a fixed shift handover.
devops-cloud-talent.decision: Verify the candidate's experience restoring service and maintaining infrastructure changes. Confirm rotation expectations before technical interviews.
devops-cloud-talent.output: A clear comparison of operational responsibility, platform depth and availability.

hiring-assessments.title: Calibrate a structured interview
hiring-assessments.input: Two panels disagree on candidates because one weights syntax and the other weights debugging.
hiring-assessments.decision: Choose a representative work sample, define acceptable evidence and have both panels score the same example independently.
hiring-assessments.output: A role-specific rubric with recorded scoring differences and agreed follow-up questions.

background-verification.title: Resolve an employment-date discrepancy
background-verification.input: One employer's confirmation shows a different end date from the candidate's application.
background-verification.decision: Check consent and agreed scope, invite clarification and route the discrepancy to the designated decision-maker with its evidence.
background-verification.output: A documented disposition and an audit trail of what was verified.

compensation-benchmarking.title: Price a specialist role in a second city
compensation-benchmarking.input: A national salary band combines individual contributors with team leads.
compensation-benchmarking.decision: Match role scope, location, experience and fixed versus variable pay. Mark sparse comparison groups so outliers do not set the band.
compensation-benchmarking.output: A comparable range with assumptions and decision notes for the hiring manager.

remote-team-building.title: Set up a distributed delivery pod
remote-team-building.input: A product owner works in London while development and QA operate from India.
remote-team-building.decision: Agree overlap hours, handovers, equipment readiness and escalation coverage. Test the first sprint's dependencies before the team starts.
remote-team-building.output: A team charter with role ownership, communication windows and onboarding milestones.

cross-border-compliance-support.title: Prepare a multi-country staffing handoff
cross-border-compliance-support.input: The client, worker and contracting entity are in different jurisdictions.
cross-border-compliance-support.decision: Collect the proposed arrangement and route classification, payroll and documentation questions to the client's authorised advisers before onboarding.
cross-border-compliance-support.output: A tracked list of documents, approvals and unresolved decisions by owner.

go-to-market-strategy.title: Launch a managed cloud offer
go-to-market-strategy.input: The practice can deliver the service, but sales is pitching the same deck to IT directors and finance leaders.
go-to-market-strategy.decision: Choose an initial segment, buying trigger and entry offer. Test the pitch against the objections on recent discovery calls.
go-to-market-strategy.output: A launch brief connecting the offer, evidence, audience and first sales conversation.

icp-buyer-personas.title: Separate the sponsor from the evaluator
icp-buyer-personas.input: Recent deals include IT managers who ran evaluations and CFOs who approved spend.
icp-buyer-personas.decision: Review won and lost opportunities by role. Capture what each person needed to believe and which proof changed their decision.
icp-buyer-personas.output: A buying-group map and segment criteria sales can use to qualify accounts.

marketing-audits.title: Find where enquiries lose momentum
marketing-audits.input: Ads report conversions, yet sales receives very few enquiries it can act on.
marketing-audits.decision: Trace selected enquiries from click through form, routing and first response. Compare channel reports with CRM records.
marketing-audits.output: A prioritised audit distinguishing tracking errors, targeting issues and response delays.

competitive-positioning.title: Explain why a buyer would switch
competitive-positioning.input: A prospect sees little difference between two implementation proposals except price.
competitive-positioning.decision: Compare alternatives against an actual buying decision. Identify one claim the delivery team can demonstrate with evidence.
competitive-positioning.output: A positioning brief and objection responses grounded in the customer's choice.

account-based-marketing.title: Open a discussion with a target account
account-based-marketing.input: A manufacturer has announced a platform change involving operations, IT and procurement.
account-based-marketing.decision: Map stakeholders and build a hypothesis for each role. Agree with sales what counts as account engagement before launching outreach.
account-based-marketing.output: An account plan linking evidence, contacts, campaign activity and the next sales action.

linkedin-lead-generation.title: Start a conversation with a hiring leader
linkedin-lead-generation.input: A target company is recruiting across several delivery roles, but the reason for the hiring burst is unclear.
linkedin-lead-generation.decision: Use public context to frame a relevant question. Qualify the reply and record consent or a request to stop follow-up.
linkedin-lead-generation.output: A documented conversation passed to sales with the need, contact and agreed next step.

outbound-outreach.title: Test a new segment before scaling
outbound-outreach.input: A team wants to contact a large list of prospects with one generic pitch.
outbound-outreach.decision: Select a small, relevant segment. Check source quality and suppression rules, then test one offer and read the replies by intent.
outbound-outreach.output: A decision on audience and message, with exclusions carried into the next send.

landing-pages-nurture.title: Connect a webinar registration to the next conversation
landing-pages-nurture.input: Registrants include live attendees, absentees and existing customers.
landing-pages-nurture.decision: Match the page promise to the invitation. Branch follow-up by attendance and interest, then route explicit requests to sales.
landing-pages-nurture.output: A campaign page and nurture sequence with clear suppression and handoff rules.

attribution-pipeline-reporting.title: Explain a deal touched by several campaigns
attribution-pipeline-reporting.input: A first search visit, a webinar and a sales workshop all appear against one account.
attribution-pipeline-reporting.decision: Reconstruct the opportunity timeline and distinguish sourced pipeline from influenced pipeline. Agree how duplicate contact records are handled.
attribution-pipeline-reporting.output: A pipeline report with definitions the finance and sales teams can reconcile.

seo.title: Fix a service page competing with its own category
seo.input: Two pages rank intermittently for the same enquiry and visitors land on the less useful one.
seo.decision: Compare intent, indexing signals and internal links. Give each page a distinct purpose or consolidate where the content serves the same need.
seo.output: A page-level change list with a baseline for search visibility and qualified enquiries.

aeo.title: Answer a buyer's comparison question
aeo.input: Sales repeatedly explains the difference between two delivery models, but the website never addresses it directly.
aeo.decision: Write a clear answer, qualify it with scope and exceptions, and give the reader a way to verify the claim.
aeo.output: A buyer-readable answer page with supporting evidence and a maintenance owner.

geo.title: Check how an AI answer describes the offer
geo.input: A buyer researching the category encounters an outdated description of the company's services.
geo.decision: Review a defined prompt set, record the source links that appear and reconcile public descriptions with the current service scope.
geo.output: A dated observation log and an evidence-led content backlog.

local-seo.title: Correct a branch's local search presence
local-seo.input: A location listing points to an old phone number and a page for a different branch.
local-seo.decision: Verify business details with the branch owner and align the listing, contact page and location-specific services.
local-seo.output: A consistent branch profile and a way to track relevant calls or direction requests.

lead-operations-automation.title: Route a repeat enquiry without double assignment
lead-operations-automation.input: An existing customer submits a campaign form using a different email alias.
lead-operations-automation.decision: Agree how to match the account and decide whether the account manager or inbound sales owns follow-up.
lead-operations-automation.output: A tested routing flow with duplicate handling and a visible exception queue.

ai-content-operations.title: Turn a workshop into a publishable article
ai-content-operations.input: A transcript contains useful technical detail alongside private customer information.
ai-content-operations.decision: Build an approved source pack, remove confidential material and assign an expert reviewer for claims before publication.
ai-content-operations.output: An edited article with traceable evidence, review history and a named owner.

reporting-spend-guardrails.title: Catch spend continuing after an offer closes
reporting-spend-guardrails.input: A campaign keeps running after its landing page switches to a waiting list.
reporting-spend-guardrails.decision: Monitor destination availability and budget pacing. Decide who can pause spend and how the owner is notified.
reporting-spend-guardrails.output: An actionable alert and a tested pause-and-resume process.

conversational-ai.title: Route a pricing question to the right team
conversational-ai.input: A visitor asks for a quote that depends on contract size, region and implementation scope.
conversational-ai.decision: Use approved information for the initial answer, gather only what sales needs and transfer unanswered questions with their context.
conversational-ai.output: A documented conversation flow with escalation, consent and transcript review.

crm-integration.title: Carry campaign source into an opportunity
crm-integration.input: Marketing sees a form fill while sales creates a new opportunity without its campaign context.
crm-integration.decision: Agree field ownership and identifiers, test an existing contact and check updates flowing back from opportunity stages.
crm-integration.output: A mapped lead-to-opportunity record with reconciliation and error handling.

paid-search.title: Separate urgent buying searches from research
paid-search.input: A campaign for implementation services also attracts people looking for training and login help.
paid-search.decision: Review actual queries with sales, isolate commercial intent and align each ad group with the right service page.
paid-search.output: A search campaign with exclusions, conversion definitions and a budget review plan.

paid-social.title: Test proof against a product pitch
paid-social.input: Two audiences see the same generic ad despite having different roles in the buying decision.
paid-social.decision: Design a creative comparison around one decision and hold the landing page constant. Review qualified responses alongside cost.
paid-social.output: A creative learning record that explains what to test next and why.

landing-page-optimisation.title: Find why visitors abandon a demo form
landing-page-optimisation.input: Enquiries fall on mobile even though campaign traffic and audience mix appear stable.
landing-page-optimisation.decision: Check field errors, keyboard behaviour, load speed and the promise above the form. Prioritise one hypothesis for a controlled change.
landing-page-optimisation.output: A tested revision and a record of conversion quality as well as completion rate.

analytics-roi-tracking.title: Reconcile a campaign's reported return
analytics-roi-tracking.input: An ad platform counts a sale twice while finance records a refund later in the month.
analytics-roi-tracking.decision: Agree revenue basis, deduplication keys and reporting windows. Reconcile sample transactions before calculating return.
analytics-roi-tracking.output: A measurement sheet with reconciled revenue, spend and stated attribution assumptions.

brand-strategy-identity.title: Unify a brand after adding a second service line
brand-strategy-identity.input: The sales deck and website present the new service as if it belonged to a different company.
brand-strategy-identity.decision: Define what the parent brand stands for and where each practice needs its own emphasis. Test the system on a homepage and proposal cover.
brand-strategy-identity.output: A practical identity system with approved positioning and reusable applications.

website-ux-design.title: Help buyers find the right specialist service
website-ux-design.input: The navigation groups capabilities by internal team names that new visitors do not recognise.
website-ux-design.decision: Map the questions buyers bring, test alternative navigation labels and prototype the path from service discovery to enquiry.
website-ux-design.output: A tested page architecture with responsive layouts and handoff specifications.

social-media-management.title: Plan a month around a specialist practice
social-media-management.input: A delivery team has valuable expertise but can spare only one interview each month.
social-media-management.decision: Turn that interview into posts with distinct purposes. Assign factual approval and agree how commercial questions move to sales.
social-media-management.output: An editorial calendar, response ownership and a review of relevant audience engagement.

content-strategy-production.title: Build an article that helps sales answer objections
content-strategy-production.input: Prospects ask whether a migration can be phased, while the website only describes the end state.
content-strategy-production.decision: Interview the delivery lead, map the buyer's decision and verify a representative sequence with its dependencies.
content-strategy-production.output: A reviewed article, sales excerpt and internal links to the relevant service.

video-production.title: Explain a technical service in a short film
video-production.input: The subject specialist has a long presentation, but the buyer needs one clear explanation.
video-production.decision: Choose the single decision the film supports. Storyboard the sequence, confirm permissions and review a rough cut before final graphics.
video-production.output: A captioned master and channel-specific cuts with agreed review and usage rights.
